note: The level of a non-Division I school a transfer came from, entered by hand with a source: CBBD's portal names the origin school but not its level. Fields: name (as the portal names it), level D2|D3|NAIA|JUCO|INTERNATIONAL|PREP, source_url, entered_at (UTC). A non-D-I origin not listed here is NON_D1_UNCLASSIFIED (moves.js), never guessed.
